## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive; Energy and Financials are the only positive sectors while the rest are weak, and Big Tech is broadly BELOW TREND — two confirmations for NEUTRAL. Leadership: Broad (3 sectors in Top 5); style tilt: Value/Cyclical.

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Energy lead: XOM (1W: +4.14% | 1M: +9.70%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +4.46% | 1M: +11.83%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +6.61% | 1M: +18.90%) ABOVE TREND. Financials strong: C (1W: +5.60% | 1M: +2.70%) ABOVE TREND, MS (1W: +5.09% | 1M: -0.56%) RECOVERY. Tech has pockets of strength: AMAT (1W: +6.11% | 1M: +0.12%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Healthcare weak: UNH (1W: -5.32% | 1M: -2.81%) BELOW TREND, JNJ (1W: -1.19% | 1M: -3.79%) BELOW TREND. Technology lagging at the top: AAPL (1W: -1.02% | 1M: -5.46%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -6.68% | 1M: -3.05%) BELOW TREND. Real Estate and Consumer Staples show notable weakness (WELL, AMT, UL, EL all BELOW TREND).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5: SLB (1W: +9.49% | 1M: -1.42%) RECOVERY, PSX (1W: +6.61% | 1M: +18.90%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +6.11% | 1M: +0.12%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +6.10% | 1M: +17.38%) ABOVE TREND, C (1W: +5.60% | 1M: +2.70%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (3 sectors in Top 5) — concentration in Energy/Financials but Tech present.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: PANW (1W: -7.08% | 1M: +9.07%) CORRECTION, UL (1W: -7.34% | 1M: -17.43%) BELOW TREND, TTWO (1W: -7.43% | 1M: -2.16%) BELOW TREND, WELL (1W: -7.76% | 1M: -5.84%) BELOW TREND, AMT (1W: -7.95% | 1M: -10.36%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Real Estate and Staples.

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Highest 1W movers: SLB (1W: +9.49% | 1M: -1.42%) RECOVERY, PSX (1W: +6.61% | 1M: +18.90%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +6.11% | 1M: +0.12%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +6.10% | 1M: +17.38%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +5.46% | 1M: -1.30%) RECOVERY — watch RECOVERY names (SLB, LRCX, MS) for follow-through as this is a major divergence signal.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Mixed to weak; selective semis outperform while mega-cap FAANGs remain soft. AMAT (1W: +6.11% | 1M: +0.12%) ABOVE TREND and AMD (1W: +4.62% | 1M: +4.46%) ABOVE TREND versus NVDA (1W: -3.70% | 1M: -8.53%) BELOW TREND and MSFT (1W: -6.68% | 1M: -3.05%) BELOW TREND — internal rotation, breadth skew negative.

8. Financials Outlook?  
Mixed but constructive at the top: C (1W: +5.60% | 1M: +2.70%) ABOVE TREND and JPM (1W: +1.92% | 1M: -1.77%) RECOVERY show leadership while V (1W: -1.52% | 1M: -0.90%) BELOW TREND highlights uneven internals. Sector showing relative strength versus broader market weakness.

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Defensive names are not leading; sector broadly weak. JNJ (1W: -1.19% | 1M: -3.79%) BELOW TREND and UNH (1W: -5.32% | 1M: -2.81%) BELOW TREND despite positive FDA headlines for peers — watch for sentiment/price divergence.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Favor Energy and select Financials (XOM (1W: +4.14% | 1M: +9.70%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +4.46% | 1M: +11.83%) ABOVE TREND, C (1W: +5.60% | 1M: +2.70%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to large-cap Tech where AAPL (1W: -1.02% | 1M: -5.46%) BELOW TREND and MSFT (1W: -6.68% | 1M: -3.05%) BELOW TREND show stress; monitor RECOVERY names (SLB, LRCX, MS) for confirmatory follow-through.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: PSX (1W: +6.61% | 1M: +18.90%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +4.14% | 1M: +9.70%) ABOVE TREND, C (1W: +5.60% | 1M: +2.70%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -3.70% | 1M: -8.53%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -6.68% | 1M: -3.05%) BELOW TREND, EL (1W: -19.60% | 1M: -36.56%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +4.92% | 1M: +14.24%) — primary positive sector; Financials (1W: +0.94% | 1M: -3.32%) — leadership potential.  
BEARISH: Technology (1W: -2.71% | 1M: +0.31%) and Healthcare (1W: -3.01% | 1M: -7.49%) — risk of further downside absent clear breadth improvement.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
Watch follow-through in RECOVERY names (SLB, LRCX, MS) to confirm rotation into cyclicals; failure to hold weekly gains would negate the move. For Tech, sustained weakness in NVDA and MSFT would keep the market in neutral; a weekly reversal in C or XOM would reinforce cyclical leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
JNJ (+55): JNJ (1W: -1.19% | 1M: -3.79%) BELOW TREND — positive FDA headline but price is not confirming (divergence).  
(Other high-score names in the dataset have limited overlap with provided price detail; monitor MD T / BMY headlines for confirmation in the tape.)

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
UNH (-65): UNH (1W: -5.32% | 1M: -2.81%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirms price weakness.  
CVX (-50): CVX (1W: +4.46% | 1M: +11.83%) ABOVE TREND — bearish headlines but price is confirming strength (divergence).  
META (-45): META (1W: -4.78% | 1M: -6.88%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price aligned.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, Value/Cyclical style. XOM (1W: +4.14% | 1M: +9.70%) ABOVE TREND and C (1W: +5.60% | 1M: +2.70%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength while AAPL (1W: -1.02% | 1M: -5.46%) BELOW TREND and MSFT (1W: -6.68% | 1M: -3.05%) BELOW TREND show large-cap tech stress. Key risk: major divergence between bullish headlines (JNJ) and prices and concentrated leadership in Energy/Financials — watch RECOVERY names for confirmation.
